responsibility: Implements creation and classification of GNU Modula-2’s built-in `SYSTEM` module symbols using GCC backend types. It initializes SYSTEM scope contents, maps GCC integer, word, bitset, real, complex, pointer, and C size types into frontend symbols with recorded sizes and synthesized min/max constants, creates pseudo-functions and procedures such as `ADR`, `TSIZE`, `ROTATE`, `SHIFT`, `CAST`, and `THROW`, and provides the lookup and predicate routines that let later semantic and code-generation stages recognize SYSTEM-specific types, generic sized forms, and same-size type relationships.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation-side companion of M2System.def: it actually constructs the SYSTEM scope, creates builtin types/functions and min/max constants from GCC tree types, and implements the classification/look-up predicates that the .def file merely declares.
